summary: When an IPv6 packet is sent to a multicast address on Ethernet, the address is normally mapped to an Ethernet multicast address. This standards-track document clarifies that in some circumstances the packet may instead be sent to an Ethernet unicast address. It updates RFC 2464.

eli5.summary: Usually a message for a whole group goes out on a loudspeaker. This note says that sometimes it is fine to hand the message to just one person instead.
